bye.speaker: Mara
bye.text: Soldering iron's hot — come back when you've got code to fix.

root.speaker: Mara
root.text: Hey, new dev. This shop runs on repaired code and strong coffee. You here to earn?

work.speaker: Mara
work.text: A client's till script adds wrong. Classic off-by-something. The mission's on the board too, but I'll vouch you straight in.

bye.speaker: Old Ben
bye.text: Data never lies. People do, but data never.

root.speaker: Old Ben
root.text: Thirty years of town records in this kiosk, kid. Every answer's a query away.

work.speaker: Old Ben
work.text: Start small: pull a list from the residents table. Mind your semicolons.

bye.speaker: Junie
bye.text: Board's always there. So am I.

options.text: I'm new. Where do I begin?

root.speaker: Junie
root.text: Welcome to Starter Town, dev. First rule: the board pays, the lab teaches, the town remembers.

start.speaker: Junie
start.text: Every dev starts with one line. Print a greeting, prove the machine listens. That's mission one.

bye.speaker: Rafi
bye.text: Coins clink, code ships. See you.

root.speaker: Rafi
root.text: Best gear in Starter Town, fair prices. A dev is only as good as their machine.

work.speaker: Rafi
work.text: My discount script's embarrassing. Fix it and there's coin in it for you.

root.speaker: Theo
root.text: Theo. I've watched a hundred devs start here. Most quit at the second bug.

tip.speaker: Theo
tip.text: Read the error. All of it. Out loud if you have to. The machine is always telling you exactly what's wrong.
